_readme: Fill a photo slot by adding an entry keyed by slot id (portrait, karting, rain, cockpit, podium, saopaulo). Put the image file in this folder. Only use photos you have the rights to, and give the credit the licence requires. Example: "portrait": { "src": "assets/photos/portrait.jpg", "alt": "Ayrton Senna, 1988", "caption": "Suzuka, 1988", "credit": "Photographer Name", "licence": "CC BY-SA 4.0", "source": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/..." }
